settings.heading: On the fifth edition.
settings.body:
Each year we ask the same question, and the answer changes. This edition asks how a garment can hold up in the weather without showing it. How an interior surface can do the work of a coat without announcing itself. Twelve pieces follow, made in numbers that allow us to know each one.

Members will receive their pieces with a card noting which one it is, and where it was made. We hope you wear them gently and often.

settings.heading: Three pieces.
settings.intro: Each piece is numbered, made in limited count, and named. The list below is the manifest in full.
settings.footnote: Pieces are made in limited number. Once the edition closes, it does not reopen.
